title: Daily Summary — 2026-05-17
body:
## Recent Activity

Activity in the 2026-05-16 → 2026-05-17 window was light: one open PR received follow-up questions from the maintainer and a new guest post discussion was published. No issues were updated and no commits were recorded in the sync window.

## Recently Active PRs

**[PR #41](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/41) — feat: add Transcript component for episode caption rendering (#40)**
- Status: **OPEN**, not yet merged. Branch: `agent/implement-issue-40/claude-25903281071`.
- The PR went through multiple Sepo review/fix-pr cycles and reached a **SHIP** verdict on 2026-05-15. All prior BLOCKING and WARNING findings were resolved (split/escaping bugs, ARIA semantics, `ignorePatterns` revert).
- New activity on 2026-05-17: @lolipopshock asked why caption files use `.md` instead of `.srt`. Sepo explained the rationale (Quartz's `allFiles` pipeline only processes `.md`; the feature is a readable text transcript, not cue-synced captions). @lolipopshock clarified the minimum bar — store caption files and optionally render them — and Sepo confirmed PR #41 already satisfies both. The PR is ready for human merge.

## Recently Active Issues

No issues were updated in the sync window (issueCount: 0).

## Recently Active Discussions

**[Discussion #46](https://github.com/orgs/augmented-mind/discussions/46) — "The Human Measure: AI Needs Personalization Beyond 'One-Size-Fits-All'"**
- Author: @CongJie-Pan (guest post, General category). Posted 2026-05-17.
- Content: A structured essay arguing for three layers of AI personalization — style-level adaptation, deep user modeling, and pluralistic alignment across cultures. References Anthropic's HHH alignment work, the "inversion problem" (Kleinberg et al.), and the Augmented Mind EP01 conversation with Omar Shaikh. No comments yet.

## Follow-ups

1. **Merge PR #41** — it has a SHIP verdict, all agent review cycles are complete, and @lolipopshock confirmed the scope is correct. Only human merge is blocking the caption infrastructure from landing.
2. **Caption-workflow PR (#44)** — stacks on PR #41 and closes issues #37/#43; should be reviewed and merged once #41 lands.
3. **Respond to Discussion #46** — the guest post has no comments yet; a brief editorial acknowledgment or question from the maintainer would be a natural next step.
